import os
from cyhole import Client

api_key = os.getenv('HELIUS_API_KEY')
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")

wallet_address = input("Enter wallet address: ")

client = Client(api_key=api_key)
assets = client.helius.get_das_assets(owner=wallet_address)

for asset in assets:
    print(f"Asset ID: {asset.id}")
    print(f"Name: {asset.content.metadata.name}")
    print(f"Symbol: {asset.content.metadata.symbol}")
    print()
